ideas.title: Following the Money in Federal Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial aspects of federal investigations, including the Feeding Our Future investigation and the investigation into child sex-change procedures.
questions: What are the financial implications of these investigations?
How are the investigations being funded?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money in these investigations could reveal important information about the scope and scale of the issues. By analyzing the financial data, we may be able to identify patterns or connections that are not immediately apparent.
